code.why: The customer life and SDK examples run through the pack fetch on an in-memory World. The host listener factory is outside those walks (architecture, Coverage); standalone mounting is checked by invariants.

Only a malformed POST /_twin/accounts fixture reaches this validation. The editor calls balance after connecting a platform-issued key, and the published balance examples assume an account. No vendor balance refusal or documented option is excluded.

The editor and pinned SDK address v2 balance only to api.tripo3d.ai or api.tripo3d.com. This branch refuses a peer sending a v2 balance request to a host outside its declared servers, including the v3-only hosts; no published balance example sends one.
